title: Money
description: A reusable exact monetary amount for boundaries that are not already scoped to one currency. RFC 0001 bidding-unit commands use *_minor_units fields instead; every such field references the shared $defs below so all implementations share one integer range.

minor_units.description: Amount in the currency's minor unit.

minorUnits.description: Non-negative amount in minor units. The upper bound is 2^53 - 1 so every conforming amount is exact in JSON, IEEE 754 doubles, and 64-bit integers.

optionalMinorUnits.description: Amount in minor units, or null when absent.

positiveMinorUnits.description: Strictly positive amount in minor units.
